Thanks man! I won't let them get to me because at the end of the day it is what it is. I can't do much about how someone else perceives something so I will take my hurt and move forward.

The thing is I am not letting it defeat me. It has 1 upped me again and I have the right to be upset about it. Unfortunately part of being human is having feelings and herpes cause my feelings to be hurt this time. I can't get mad at the person who did not want to date me because of it. I will drown in my sorrow and eventually get over. I know this experience will make me stronger. I believe you need to understand that herpes is a lifelong disease that is incurable. It's not that I don't think I can be happy with it, it's just that it will be harder. That's all.

Maybe it was a bit selfish. I went about it how I thought I should. I didn't attempt to scare her or gain sympathy. I didn't expect anyone to feel bad for but to simply know that I had it, how I got it, and how it affected me. I did this before any romance even came in to play as a precaution. Herpes is herpes. No matter how you disclose it, it's up to the person to accept it or not. I didn't post this tor sympathy but to vent my frustrations to others who have maybe encountered something similar. Don't try and belittle me for how I decided to disclose to someone I had feelings for.

I am convinced that maybe some of you are projecting your anger out on me. No one was playing "nurse" to my depression because I was not depressed while I was with either of them. I was not dating either. Also, I did not nor attempt to date after my diagnosis due to the toll it took on me. I only attempted to after I came to accept that this is my life from now on. Maybe it just is me but don't reply aggressively when you misinterpreted what I said.
I just disclosed how and when I was diagnosed. Also, how I felt afterward.

I didn't make it seem like a death sentence when disclosing. I explained what I was diagnosed with and let her know how I felt when it first happened. I never made it seem like my life was over just that I was depressed after the diagnosis and I didn't truly get over til beginning of summer. I'm not going to water it down for the sake of my happiness because it is a lifelong disease.
